Any source TEXT copied below is offline authoring evidence: do not make it legible merely because the object is visible. Keep undisclosed reading text blank or illegible until an engine-disclosed reading result is available.
Source-backed purple book. Preserve the source name, material, colour and distinctive shape; art estimates do not change portability, weight or interaction rules.
Source text/inscriptions (retain original guards and current-observation concealment; not unconditional ambient text):
LDESC: Lying in the dust, and covered with mold, is a purple book.
TEXT: This book is written in a tongue with which I am unfamiliar. Assuming that one can indeed tell a book by its cover, it is likely filled with purple prose, the like of which is rarely seen outside the Great Underground Empire.
Use the approved low-poly palette except where source puzzle colours take precedence. Keep this one canonical brief for movement between rooms. Source alias appearances may need room-specific variants; do not globally turn every purple book into the same geometry. Contents, destruction, disappearance and light remain engine-controlled.
